chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Maqarri narrated to us, saying: Abu Amr Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Maqarri al-Jarjani narrated to us, saying: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Mosuli in Baghdad narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn 'Asim al-Turayfi narrated to us, saying: Abu Zaid 'Ayyash ibn Yazid ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Kahhal, the freedman of Zaid ibn Ali, narrated to us, saying: My father, Yazid ibn al-Hasan, narrated to us, saying: Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon them both) narrated to me, saying: [Al-Sadiq, Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both), said:]

The one who sends blessings upon the Prophet (peace be upon him and his Family), its meaning is: Indeed, I am upon the covenant and the loyalty which I accepted when He said: 'Am I not your Lord?' to which they said: 'Yes.'

key_terms.أَلَسْتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ: Am I not your Lord? (Quranic verse reference)

ai.seo_question: What is the theological meaning of sending blessings upon the Prophet according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq linking the ritual of *Salat* to the primordial covenant (*Al-Mithaq*) of 'Am I not your Lord?' (7:172), thereby elevating it from mere supplication to an affirmation of divine fidelity. This interpretation underscores the Shia view that sending blessings is a continuous renewal of the soul's pledge to God, rooted in the Prophet's role as the guarantor of this covenant for all humanity.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Ahmad bin Muhammed bin Abdul-Rahman al-Maqarri, that he said: We were told by Abu Amru, Muhammed bin Ja’far al-Maqarri al-Jarjani, that he said: We were told by Abu Bakr, Muhammed bin Hasan al-Mosuli in Baghdad, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin ‘Asim al-Turayfi, that he said: We were told by Abu Zaid, ‘Ayyash bin Yazid bin Hasan bin Ali al-Kahhal, the servant of Zaid bin Ali, that he said: We were told by my father, Yazid bin Hasan, that he said: I was told by Musa bin Ja’far, peace be upon them both, that he said: Al-Sadiq, Ja’far bin Muhammed, peace be upon them both, said:

The one who (recites the prayer in which one) sends blessings upon the Prophet, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, its meaning is: Indeed, I am on the covenant and the loyalty which I have accepted during His saying: «Am I not your Lord» to which they said: «Sure».
